page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; no margin notes, no footnotes. Running head at the top centre.

main_text.p: ritissimo primum hunc animi mei partum dedicare volui; tum ut meam ipsi indu-striam promptamque iuuandi rem literariam voluntatem probarem, tum ut memorem & gratum animum meum hac ratione declararem ac testatum facerem.

Quapropter humiliter & obnixe rogo & obsecro, ut T. G. pro innata sua & plane heroica humanitate ac beneuolentia hoc leuidense munusculum, tanquam tesseram mei erga se cultus & adfectus, sereno vultu suscipiat, suaque autoritatis scuto, contra maligni liuoris dentem, tegat & defendat.
Quod si hac in re fauoris tui auram suauiter coeptis votisque meis aspirare sensero, efficiam cum Deo, ut T. G. uberiores aliquando studiorum meo-rum fructus percipiat & consequatur.
Quam interim cum coniuge & sobole Generosa, totaque illustri domo Bentheimica præpotentis Dei protectioni commendo, utque eam in bonum Ec-clesiæ,

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. The page opens mid-sentence, so the first paragraph is marked as a continuation. The word "tesseram" is read from a line break ("tesse-" / "ram") and is a probable reading. "leuidense" is printed with a clear long s and may be a printer's variant spelling. No page number, catchword or signature is printed.
